_comment: Run by internal/connconfig. Generated from what the Perl API's lib/API/ConnectionConfig.pm returned (the Perl code and its generator are in git history); edited by hand since. 'input' is the raw request JSON. Go must match every case whose fields have their proper JSON types (strings, a number for Port, booleans for Ssl/SASL) and refuse the rest. The exempt cases follow config.DefaultNetworkPort: DEFAULT_NETWORK_PORT is a whole number from 1 to 65535 or 6667, no longer Perl's int().
